_comment: TMNT (1987) 'Complete Classic Series Collection' (hash e37b9068…, 205 files as dmmdb's AvailableFile lists them on 2026-11-11) placed on the 2003 series (TMDB 2284, IMDb tt0318913), with TMDB's own answers for that show and its seasons 0-7 recorded the same day. Before the 12 s event-loop stall of 2026-11-11 08:11 the replica asked TMDB for 2284 season 8 and got 404; the request bodies are not logged, so this pairing reproduces that lookup rather than replaying a captured request.
